qrencoder.py is copied unchanged from the bundled ReportLab distribution's
reportlab/graphics/barcode/qrencoder.py. It has no ReportLab imports and uses
only Python's standard library. Original license and attribution remain in
the source header. No runtime download or external QR service is required.
SHA256: d604f2d1352562d4a5857ba5e54ee5635364c3b3d2f8f2b26a6b6b60cf0c6a99

Copyright (c) 2009 Kazuhiko Arase
Ported from the Javascript library by Sam Curren.
Support for Kanji, Hanzi, ECI, FNC1 and Structured append,
and optimizations by Anders Hammarquist.
